Survey indices

Source: R/stockpile_values.R
stockpile_indices.Rd

Get the survey indices for one or more stock assessments. By default the latest version of each stock assessment is returned.

Usage

stockpile_indices(
  stock_code = NULL,
  assessment_year = NULL,
  version = "latest",
  as_of = NULL,
  index = NULL,
  url = stockpile_url(),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

stock_code

stock codes, for example "sol.27.7d". The default is all stocks.

assessment_year

assessment years. The default is all years.

version

"latest" for the most recent version of each stock assessment, "all" for every version, or version numbers.

as_of

a date or time, to see the stockpile as it stood then: only versions submitted up to that time are used. A date means the start of that day.

index

the names of the indices to return. The default is all indices.

url

the location of the stockpile, see stockpile_url().

refresh

read the table again, even if it has already been read in this session.

Value

A data frame with one row per value, as in stockpile_values(), and also:

index

the name of the index

slot

the slot, named as in an FLIndex, for example "index"

startf, endf

the part of the year the survey covers

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
stockpile_indices("whg.27.7b-ce-k")
} # }
